title: Historically sourced natural uranium seed and finite mining budgets
status: Sourced seed data, not in-game validation. Country resources are 2001-reference proxies for2000 bookmark; they are not exact Jan1 2000 mine reserves.

units.stock_and_reserve: metric tonnes of elemental uranium (tU), not ore or U3O8
units.native_trade_resource_unit: 100 kg U/week nominal integer flow; capacity and source production remain tU

model_choices.max_weekly_formula: max(initial_weekly_tu, reserve_tu / (20 *52)); rounded downward to6decimals for reserve-based component
model_choices.existing_capacity_floor: Existing 1999 mining flow may exceed the20year expansion budget and can exhaust earlier. It is not reduced solely to fit20years.
model_choices.expansion_counter: Finite geometric steps: new mine base min(1,max_weekly_tu), then multiply1.5 per expansion until the state max. Existing mine starts at initial_weekly_tu. Never create a second country reserve pool at each site.
model_choices.fractional_flow: Native add_resource is integer. Convert tU/week capacity to 100kg/week units, floor the promised effective-safe base flow, and preserve the remaining unextracted material. Deposits below the industrial 100kg/week quantum cannot start commercial mining. This quantum is an explicit engine/game approximation.
model_choices.depletion: Every week remove actual extracted tonnes from remaining reserve; clamp extraction to remaining reserve; imported material never increases ore still underground.
model_choices.enrichment: No geological cap on enrichment facilities. They must consume imported or domestically mined natural feed; geological restrictions apply to mining only.
model_choices.national_to_state_allocation: Shares without deposit-level measured reserves are explicit game allocations of a single finite country total among confirmed districts, not geological measurements.
model_choices.unclassified_resource_policy: China73000KCR and India54470RAR, both without cost classification, are separate historical fields and optional conservative game proxy budgets. Do not present them as RAR<130.
model_choices.unknown_policy: null means not reported/unavailable, never proven zero or no deposits. No arbitrary finite or infinite reserve is generated for unknown budgets.
model_choices.greenland_policy: Known DEN-reported deposit remains geographically in GRL state1; seed deferred because state1 is impassable.

historical_trade_price_reference.note: EU utility supply weighted prices. Natural uranium excludes conversion, enrichment services and fuel fabrication. EUR figures are1999EUR and cannot be equated toUSD.
